organization.name_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism

affected.note: At least about 76,000 email addresses: about 54,000 of ministry staff and about 22,000 of external parties on ministry mailing lists, as found by 2021-05-26. System configuration information also leaked. Fujitsu later said data of 129 customer organizations leaked through ProjectWEB.

summary.en: The transport ministry announced that information related to it leaked through unauthorized access to ProjectWEB, a project information-sharing tool run by Fujitsu. At least about 76,000 email addresses of staff and external contacts, plus system configuration information, were taken.
summary.ja: 国土交通省は、富士通が管理・運営するプロジェクト情報共有ツール「ProjectWEB」への不正アクセスにより、同省関係の情報が流出したと公表した。職員や外部関係者のメールアドレス少なくとも約7.6万件とシステム構成情報が流出した。
